name: Contribution within a biological system
description: Represent a target’s specific responsibility in a multi-component process: execution, activation, cofactor supply, assembly, positioning, reset or another bounded contribution.
claim_scope: A causal contribution to a named cellular/biochemical system, distinct from whole-system output and association alone.
distinctions: Required component versus performer of headline chemistry.
Enzyme-like fold versus activation of another catalyst.
Pairwise binding versus simultaneous scaffolding/productive assembly.
ATPase versus reset enabling repeated product formation.
A real phenotype versus an unresolved physical connector.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: Association/co-migration does not establish direct chemistry or stable membership.
A family-site expectation does not prove the target mutant catalytically null.
One endpoint does not establish every stage of system operation.
Participation can be supported while the connector is unresolved.
boundary: A01 describes direct operation; A06 its system responsibility. A08 gives physiological consequences and A09 necessity given alternatives.

evidence.source_locator: 2013 relevant Results/Methods; Table 1; active-site and stable/localized variant comparisons.
evidence.observation: Absent active-LytM zinc coordination and stable septal activation-defective variants support amidase activation instead of copied peptidase chemistry.
evidence.limit: Direct complex detection failed and helix-contact mechanism remains proposed.

evidence.source_locator: Protospacer integration Results; Fig. 1 and Extended Data Figs. 2–3.
evidence.observation: Cas2 E9Q supports integration while an assembly-interface deletion does not; Cas1 active-site variants fail.
evidence.limit: No directly demonstrated E. coli Cas2 nuclease-null assay; low Cas1-only Mn2+ activity bounds absolute necessity.

evidence.source_locator: Protospacer-capture Results/Methods; trace descriptive 5DS4/5DS5 coordinate analysis.
evidence.observation: Donor-DNA structures and acquisition variants assign a positive DNA-positioning/assembly contribution rather than an absence-only passive label.
evidence.limit: Static geometry is not necessity/binding affinity; not every clamp variant has an independent affinity assay.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant primary body and methods, including substrate tests, filtrate reconstitution and structure work, inspected.
evidence.observation: Protein-free reaction filtrate activates apo-Fdc1, assigning cofactor-supply chemistry to UbiX rather than downstream decarboxylation.
evidence.limit: Native DMAP source and universal precursor specificity remain unestablished.

evidence.source_locator: 2018 single/multiple-turnover Results/Methods and Discussion; trace T1.
evidence.observation: TmTsaBD makes/releases one product without TsaE, but ATPase-defective TsaE fails sustained turnover, locating a reset contribution.
evidence.limit: Species/assay discrepancy with E. coli endpoint evidence remains open.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Three full primary papers inspected. Downloaded 76-file GEO processed-track archive and exact reference feature table; interrogated selected tracks in known cggR/gapA, glnR/glnA, rpoB and rnpB windows. No raw-read realignment or formal replication statistics.
evidence.observation: Selected transcript-processing defects support a bounded RNase Y accessory contribution rather than all RNase Y activity or resolved direct phosphorelay action.
evidence.limit: Conflicting historical studies remain; selected deposited-track windows were inspected without raw-read realignment.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Publisher full Results examined, including 10/12 suppressors and turnover controls.
evidence.observation: LpxC turnover, suppressors and LapB association support LPS-synthesis regulation; lipid effects alone did not establish cardiolipin transport.
evidence.limit: Does not settle every molecular contact or every YejM function.
